# AutoFillPDF

> AutoFillPDF is an online tool that converts any PDF form (including scanned, non-fillable, or image-based PDFs) into a clean web form, allows users to fill it digitally with optional autofill from saved profiles, add signatures, and download a completed PDF with answers overlaid on the original document.

## What AutoFillPDF Does

AutoFillPDF eliminates the need for printing, handwriting, and scanning PDF forms. Users upload any PDF form, fill out a clean web form interface, add their signature using a built-in signature pad, and download the completed document ready for submission.

## Key Features

- Works with ANY PDF: scanned documents, photos of forms, non-fillable PDFs, image-based forms
- OCR-powered field detection that reads text from images
- Clean web form interface for easy filling
- Built-in signature pad - sign directly in browser
- One-click autofill from saved profiles (Pro feature)
- 256-bit encryption for data security
- Automatic file deletion (72 hours for guests, 180 days for Pro)

## Pricing

- **Guest (One-time)**: $5 per form, no account required
- **Starter**: $7/month - 2 forms included, 1 saved profile, extra forms $2 each
- **Pro+**: $15/month - 10 forms included, multiple profiles, priority processing, extra forms $2 each
- **Enterprise**: $49/month - 50 forms included, unlimited team members, bulk processing, extra forms $1.50 each

Founding Member rates through January 2026. Cancel anytime.

## How It Works

1. **Upload**: Drag and drop any PDF form - even scanned or image-based
2. **Fill**: Type answers in a clean web form, add signature
3. **Download**: Get completed PDF with answers perfectly placed

## Common Use Cases

### HR & Employment
- I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification
- W-4 Employee Withholding
- W-9 Tax ID forms
- New hire onboarding packets
- Employee handbook acknowledgments
- Benefits enrollment forms

### Real Estate
- Lease agreements and rental applications
- Purchase contracts and disclosures
- Property inspection reports
- HOA documents

### Legal & Contracts
- Court filings and legal forms
- Contracts and agreements
- Power of attorney documents
- Notary forms

### Healthcare
- Patient intake forms
- Medical history questionnaires
- Insurance claim forms
- HIPAA authorization forms

### Education
- School enrollment and registration
- Permission slips and consent forms
- Financial aid applications

### Government & Nonprofit
- Grant applications
- Permit applications
- License renewals
- Compliance forms
